# TimsabLab Homelab
### Network | Wireless | Virtualization | Servers

```
Internet (123NET Fiber, primary)      Cable Internet (backup)
        |                                      |
       ONU                              Cisco ISR 4221
        |                                192.168.99.6
  MikroTik RB4011
  192.168.99.1  (primary gateway, NTP source)
        |                                      |
        +------------------+-------------------+
                           |
                Cisco 3850 Layer-3 Core
                    192.168.99.2
              (STP root, inter-VLAN routing)
                           |
     +-----------+---------+---------+------------------+
     |           |         |         |                  |
Basement    Livingroom   Nexus 3048           pfSense HA pair
 Switch        Switch    192.168.99.5          .7 (primary)
 .3            .4        (LACP to Proxmox)     .8 (backup)
            (UniFi U7             |
             on Gi0/31)      Dell R630 / Proxmox
                              (LACP trunk uplink)
                                   |
                    +--------------+-------------+
                    |                            |
              VLAN 30 (servers)            VLAN 100 (DMZ)
              Mail VM, Keycloak VM         WebServer VM
                                           192.168.100.10
                                           (Apache reverse proxy,
                                            public entry point)

     newLivingroomSwitch (.14) -> newBoysBedroomSwitch (.15) -> officeSwitch (.16)
     (daisy-chained off the core; officeSwitch carries UniFi U6+ on Gi1/0/31,
      a Cisco AP on Gi1/0/33, and desk VoIP phones on VLAN 102/202)

     Adtran 924e (.13) also hangs off the core (managed via legacy SSH ciphers)
```

**monitoring01** (this Grafana/Prometheus host) sits on VLAN 99 (mgmt) at 192.168.99.21, with a second NIC on VLAN 30 at 192.168.30.7.

| VLAN | Name | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| 20 | vlan020-endpoints | General endpoints |
| 30 | vlan030-servers | Servers (mail, Keycloak, storage mgmt) |
| 40 | vlan040-users | User devices, phone data |
| 99 | vlan099-mgmt | Management — switches, routers, monitoring01 |
| 100 | vlan100-dmz | DMZ — public-facing reverse proxy (webserver VM) |
| 102 | vlan102-work | Desk phones / work devices |
| 110 | Cisco110 | (reserved) |
| 132 / 142 | OPEN | Unused / reserved |
| 160 | vlan160-dirty | Untrusted/guest-style segment |
| 202 | vlan202-work-voice | Work VoIP |
| 302 | vlan302-pxe | PXE boot network |
| 402 | vlan402-lab-voice | Lab VoIP |
| 999 | vlan999-native | Native/trunk VLAN across the core |

**AAA & monitoring plumbing:** TACACS+ at 192.168.30.101, RADIUS at 192.168.99.43 (same host as PRTG/DNS). SNMP read-only polling (LibreNMS + Prometheus snmp_exporter) restricted by ACL to the 192.168.99.0/24 management subnet. NTP sourced from Vlan99, synced to the MikroTik.

**Switches, routers, firewalls (SNMP)**

- [SNMP Interfaces Dashboard](/d/snmp-net-interfaces/network-devices-snmp-interfaces)
- [Network folder](/dashboards/f/dfuff38txejnkc/network)

Devices: MikroTik, Cisco 3850 (L3 core), 2x Cisco 2960, Cisco 4221, Nexus, Adtran, pfSense HA pair

**UniFi Access Points (U7 on livingroom_switch, U6+ on officeSwitch)**

- [UniFi Wireless Dashboard](/d/unifi-wireless/unifi-wireless)
- [UniFi Controller](https://192.168.99.43:8443)

**Proxmox VMs (Dell R630), TrueNAS storage**

- [Proxmox VMs Dashboard](/d/proxmox-vms/proxmox-vms)
- [Proxmox](https://192.168.99.62:8006)
- [TrueNAS](https://192.168.99.45)

VMs include: mail server, Keycloak, DMZ webserver/reverse proxy
